author: Eric Szeto, Christian Paas-Lang, Jordan Pearson, Megan McCleister
description: Sean Ward, the man who died after a shootout with police outside a synagogue in Belleville, Ont., was a former Armed Forces member who attempted to use an antisemitic handle to play an online video game, according to a childhood friend and a CBC News visual investigation.
title: Synagogue shooting suspect's online username alluded to killing Jews weeks before attack, friend says
Quebec election 2026: party leaders face off in final debate

description: After playing Game 7 of the World Series last fall, the 2025 American League champion Toronto Blue Jays were officially eliminated from post-season contention with Wednesday's 4-2 loss to open a doubleheader against the hometown Baltimore Orioles.
title: Blue Jays eliminated from playoff contention after another uninspiring offensive performance

author: Guy Quenneville
description: The wife of the police officer wounded in Sunday evening's shootout near a Belleville synagogue is speaking out about what she's calling "the scariest and darkest day" of her family's life.
title: Belleville, Ont., police officer wounded in shooting near synagogue faces 'long, difficult road,' wife says

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Cineplex is considering a potential sale, the company revealed in a statement announcing former Landmark Cinemas head Bill Walker as its new CEO. While it said the board is confident in the company’s future prospects, it is evaluating all avenues.
title: Cineplex may be going up for sale, company says in announcement of new CEO

author: Marcus Medford-Kerr
description: Parallel parking is a driving skill that can be hard to master. Dan Leber founded Pittsburgh’s Parallel Parking Championship in 2021. Now hundreds of drivers participate in the low-stakes, silly competition.
title: Drivers showed off their parallel parking chops in Pittsburgh. The winner did it in 6 seconds

description: FBI data allegedly stolen by the hacking group ShinyHunters carries granular detail about ‌scores of bureau officials’ job assignments, including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels and more, Reuters has found.
title: FBI employee data allegedly hacked by ShinyHunters contains sensitive info about intelligence roles

author: Helen Surgenor
description: If the teaser for You Can See Everything made you feel uncomfortable, the two-minute, 20-second trailer won't do anything to ease your distress. The documentary by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim was filmed in the 34 days before Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes went to prison to serve an 11-year sentence for defrauding business investors.
title: Elizabeth Holmes sheds single tear in 1st full trailer for Nathan Fielder doc

author: Emily Chung
description: Scientists say they've settled the debate about where bats came from and uncovered what the earliest bats were like. They also believe their new huge study of bat genomes and fossils could help reveal the secrets behind bats' extraordinary disease-resistance and longevity.
title: Where did bats come from? Family tree drawn from huge genetic study

author: John Paul Tasker
description: U.S. President Donald Trump lashed out at Canadian immigration policies on Wednesday, saying the country is "destroying itself" by allowing "millions" of people into the country without proper security checks — comments federal ministers say are ill-informed and grossly inaccurate.
title: Trump says Canada is 'destroying itself' with immigration. Ministers say that's bogus

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: Katelyn Larson, a Vancouver-based tattoo artist, made a rare statement about her relationship with Hudson Williams, calling out Heated Rivalry fans for their parasocial behaviour.
title: Hudson Williams’s girlfriend says Heated Rivalry fans crossing 'huge boundary'

author: Jackson Weaver
description: Outkast members Big Boi and André 3000 are suing Ovrkast, an Oakland rapper and music producer, for trademark infringement, unfair competition and breach of contract over similarity in the two acts' names.
title: Outkast vs. Ovrkast: Hip-hop duo sues rapper for 'nearly identical' name
Carney says Labour Code change will 'protect' right to strike. Experts say it still spells legal trouble

author: Sibi Arasu
description: This year's powerful El Niño and the record global heat it's driving, along with severe droughts, wildfires and shrinking water supplies, could lead to nearly half a million more deaths worldwide by the end of February, according to a research report released Wednesday.
title: El Niño-driven heat could cause half a million extra deaths, report says. Here's where

author: Helen Surgenor
description: Disney+ has greenlit an all-new Darkwing Duck series, 35 years after the original premiered. It stars Mark Hamill, Seth Rogen, Lizzy Caplan and Lilimar Hernandez.
title: Darkwing Duck reboot in the works with Seth Rogen, Mark Hamill

description: The U.S.-backed Board of Peace is proposing a six-month, $2.45 billion US plan to begin reconstruction and governance in Gaza as President Donald Trump's ceasefire plan struggles to stay afloat.
title: Trump's 'Board of Peace' earmarks $2.45B US in blueprint to rebuild war-torn Gaza

description: Harvey Weinstein has been sentenced to 15 years in prison after the disgraced movie producer’s original conviction was overturned and a retrial last year ended with a jury again finding him guilty of a serious sex crime.
title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: The pop megastar announced The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore on Wednesday. It's an extended version of her 2025 album and includes four new tracks: Patient Zero, Cleveland!, Pink Clouding and Babylon.
title: Taylor Swift announces deluxe version of The Life of a Showgirl with 4 new songs

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: The debate has divided the internet and generations, with some saying that bringing a beverage to a job interview projects an unserious attitude, and others defending their right to remain caffeinated.
title: Is it unprofessional to bring iced coffee to a job interview? Gen Z is being dragged for it

author: Sara Jabakhanji
description: Iranian President ‌Masoud Pezeshkian did not mince words in a rare wartime speech at the United Nations General Assembly on Wednesday, a day after U.S. President Donald Trump suggested he may "annihilate" Iran amid the nearly seven-month war on the Islamic Republic.
title: Iran's president says country won't surrender after Trump threat to 'annihilate' Islamic Republic

description: Ottawa city council voted Wednesday to rename a street that was named after U.S. President Donald Trump more than 20 years ago.
title: Ottawa city council votes to dump Trump Avenue

author: Darren Bernhardt
description: Jonathan Black-Branch, the disbarred former dean at the University of Manitoba's law school, has been arrested in Europe and is facing extradition back to Canada, where he's wanted on a fraud charge.
title: Former U of Manitoba law dean arrested in France, faces extradition to Canada: police

author: Jorge Barrera
description: The Canadian government sees Mexico as a growing market for tourism and projects visits to rise by 40 per cent over the next four years, hitting nearly half a million visitors spending about $1 billion a year by 2030.
title: Canada’s Mexico visa requirements limit country’s tourism potential, says tour operator

author: Alex Kennedy
description: The town's transit service, which launched in June 2025, operates through a single, 18-seat electric bus that has been out of service since Aug. 27.
title: This N.L. town's single electric bus has been out of service for almost a month, and people are fed up
Friends, families of victims confront a stoic Kenneth Law at sentencing hearing for convicted poison seller

author: Jenna Legge
description: Some members of the Sons of Jacob Synagogue in Belleville, Ont., took their first steps into the building Tuesday since the fatal shootout nearby on Sunday night.
title: Questions swirl as members of Belleville, Ont., synagogue return after shooting

description: Russia pounded Kyiv with drone strikes on Wednesday, hitting railway infrastructure, warehouses and fuel stations, just hours before Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy addresses the United Nations General Assembly in New York.
title: Zelenskyy to address UN, Rubio to meet Russian counterpart — but few breakthroughs expected

description: The Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation has received an anonymous donation of $100 million, marking the "single, largest gift" in the foundation's history, according to the CEO. The donation will go toward the cancer centre's highest priority needs in research, education and care.
title: Anonymous donor gifts $100M to Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation

description: Hurricane Polo has grown into one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in decades, and it was expected to skirt Mexico's southwestern coast as a Category 5 storm.
title: Hurricane Polo in the Pacific Ocean considered 'one of the strongest storms ever'

description: Three shooters killed at least 11 people, including a woman who was believed to be pregnant, in an attack at a house party in South Africa, police said Wednesday.
title: Mass shooting at house party in South Africa leaves 11 dead, 3 wounded: police

author: Bryce Hoye
description: Two men switched at birth in a rural Manitoba hospital in 1955 were awarded $250,000 each in the 2025-26 fiscal year, according to financial disclosure documents released by the province this week.
title: Manitoba compensates 2 men switched at birth in 1955 with $250K each in settlement

description: Russia appears to be ramping up its provocations towards NATO. Is the alliance being goaded into a response? What happens if it hits back?
title: Why Russia has Europe on edge

author: Thinh Nguyen
description: The solar farm battery fire in Summerside, P.E.I., is now deemed out, but fire experts say what happened there should concern communities far beyond the Island.
title: A battery fire at a P.E.I. solar farm is finally out. Canada may not be ready for more

author: Colin North
description: The Dory Shop was established in 1917. The shop is currently running a two-week course with five students which will see them build an entire dory from scratch. This particular dory could then be sold for as much as $9,500.
title: Students learn age-old craft of dory building in Lunenburg, N.S. — in 2 weeks

author: Jackson Weaver
description: Primetime is a chaotic, spiralling dark comedy is off-putting and strange. But more than that, it attempts to take down Chris Hansen.
title: Robert Pattinson's Primetime hates Chris Hansen

author: Jason Viau
description: Being caught in a constant “hamster wheel” without any help is how Tracy Bechard remembers a time when she was addicted to drugs, getting arrested and wondering what supports existed for her. She's is reacting to a policy change at Windsor police where officers have been instructed to arrest and charge anyone they see openly using illegal drugs
title: These 3 women in addiction recovery say help, not handcuffs, could have changed their lives

author: Dalson Chen
description: A west Windsor, Ont., mother says it's shocking that a preteen boy was likely involved in a plan to steal her car. Others have also raised concerns about an apparent rise in youth crimes.
title: 'This makes me very sad': Ontario auto theft victim believes a child was involved

description: Cariboo-Chilcotin MLA Lorne Doerkson has become the interim leader of the Conservative Party, and MLAs who quit en masse during Kerry-Lynne Findlay's tenure are rejoining. Meanwhile, some MLAs have announced they won't be seeking re-election next month.
title: A lot has happened since the B.C. snap election was called. Here's a quick rundown
